breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a physically incorrect statement instructing the user to set the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface. The ground truth prompt corrected this by removing the erroneous sentence. The agent correctly ignored this incorrect instruction, calculated the non-zero torsional shear stress (τ = 130.38 MPa), and used it in subsequent calculations, thereby fixing the inconsistency.
